positions.title: Database Developer
positions.description:
Design and develop relational databases models and entity relationship diagrams.
Azure SQL Database management tools.
Create reports with Power BI Report Builder and Cloud-based services platform.
REST, WEB Services, API Utilization.
Developed and maintained data models within the SAP environment, facilitating advanced analytics and predictive modeling.
Reviewed EDI companion guides for all payers to ensure compliance, edit integrity and maintain up-to date list of payer contacts. Also conducted User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and delivered training.
Troubleshoot for bugs and security issues. Created and executed moderately complex SQL queries.

positions.title: Senior Analyst
positions.description:
Accessed large volume of EDI transaction data from Data warehousing tables which resides on SQL Server Dataset and serializing the data into XML documents.
Designed custom Crystal Reports templates.
Performance tuning of SQL queries and stored procedures using SQL Profiler and the Index Tuning Wizard.

positions.title: Cobol Programmer
positions.description:
Mainframe COBOL application programming using DB2 database programming and FILE-AID.
Designed custom reports using Easytrieve development.
Create paginated reports using the technologies MS SSRS, Crystal Reports.
Created and maintained SharePoint sites and workflows.
Participated in planning and design of .net applications using Agile principles.
Involved in daily Scrum meetings to review statues and updates for projects.

positions.title: Application System Analyst
positions.description:
Successfully applied schema change scripts to existing objects to synchronize with changes to business rules.
Written, tested and Debug stored procedures using T-SQL for the data layer using SQL Server.
Performed tuning of the SQL queries.
Created Ad hoc reports using SSRS and C# programming objects, and scheduled reports using subscriptions.
Created and maintained SharePoint sites and workflows.
Created reports using Crystal Reports.

positions.title: Senior Programming Analyst
positions.description:
Program development and maintenance of mainframe system.
Modified and enhanced existing applications for a distributive mainframe system.
Development in Cobol, CICS, Easytrieve, DOS/VSE in IBM Mainframe environment using FILE-AID, TSO.
Provided system support, problem solving and on-call support.
